trigger.title: The Five-Year Line
trigger.body: Every big region's grid queue passes five years for a firm connection, and the reform bills stall in committee. Whoever already holds firm megawatts sets the price.

decoy.name: The SMR wave
decoy.reason: Ironvale Power and two utilities announce orderbooks for dozens of small reactors, and a fast-track licensing order follows. The orderbooks carry no funding; a handful of units ever get built.
decoy.tell: Firm Build-out jumps on announcements while the Grid Queue keeps lengthening and the Capacity Market stays at the cap. If firm power were really coming, auctions and queues would ease first; none of the orderbooks names a funded unit.
